description: Every fixture file under datasets/ with its SHA-256, size, producer, provenance category and generator command. Provenance categories: 'native' = written by an independent Parquet writer (pyarrow) including the profile metadata; 'native-with-profile-metadata' = independent-writer output to which profile metadata was added afterwards (unused so far: pyarrow writes stamps, sorting_columns and the page index itself); 'mutated' = deliberately edited by generators/mutate_metadata.py (data pages preserved unless a change says otherwise); 'generated' = a text file (manifest) written by a generator.
reproducibility: Byte-reproducible with the pinned pyarrow on Python 3.13: generators/check_reproducible.py regenerates everything in a temporary directory and compares it with the checked-in files (pyarrow 26.0.1 footers carry no timestamps). If a future writer is not byte-reproducible, the checked-in bytes stay authoritative and STRUCTURE.txt must remain identical.

datasets.name: repeated-keys
datasets.description: Repeated groups cross two-row pages and four-row row groups; groups stay within parts.

datasets.name: one-large-group
datasets.description: One group occupies an entire part, spanning six row groups and twelve pages.

datasets.description: The manifest names object.id as the key column; dots are literal.

datasets.description: A committed dataset with no parts.

datasets.name: basic
datasets.description: One part, two row groups of six rows, key pages of two rows; uncompressed PLAIN v1 pages.

datasets.name: multipart
datasets.description: Three parts listed out of file-name order, several row groups and pages each, leading/interior/trailing empty row groups, SNAPPY/ZSTD/GZIP, dictionary and DELTA_BYTE_ARRAY keys, data page v1 and v2, sha256 in the manifest, an extension, and a stray Parquet file under the root that is not part of the dataset.

datasets.name: binary-keys
datasets.description: Keys exercising unsigned byte order: NUL, 0x7F/0x80, 0xFF, invalid UTF-8, UTF-8 whose UTF-16 order differs, prefix chains, keys longer than 64 bytes (pyarrow does not shorten bounds), and long keys of 0xFF bytes. Pages of 3 rows.

datasets.name: projection
datasets.description: Projected values of every mandatory physical type with nulls, special floats given by exact bits (signed zero, infinities, NaN payloads), unsigned-annotated INT32/INT64 reported as signed physical values, and a top-level column literally named a.b; the key column carries the STRING annotation; part 1 lacks columns f64 and req, only part 2 has column extra; meta (struct) and tags (list) are nested.

datasets.name: delimiter
datasets.description: Folder-like keys: keys equal to prefixes, trailing and repeated delimiters, a delimiter at the start, non-ASCII bytes used as delimiters, keys beginning with 0xFF, and the common prefix a/b/ spanning a part boundary. Pages of 2 rows.

datasets.name: list-bounds
datasets.description: Keys a/a, a/z, b/1, b/2, c: the worked example of LIST-7 (bounds apply to candidate keys).

datasets.name: non-utf8-keys
datasets.description: An unannotated key column holding keys that are not valid UTF-8 (allowed, KEY-6). Each invalid key is in the middle of a 3-row page, so every page bound is valid UTF-8.

datasets.name: annotated
datasets.description: Columns with logical annotations whose physical values the protocol reports: DATE (INT32 days), TIMESTAMP millis and micros/UTC (INT64), DECIMAL stored as INT32, INT64 and FIXED_LEN_BYTE_ARRAY(13) (unscaled two's complement), STRING (BYTE_ARRAY).

datasets.name: encodings
datasets.description: Data pages that use the remaining mandatory encodings: part 0 is written as Parquet format 1.0 with dictionaries, so key and value data pages are PLAIN_DICTIONARY; part 1 uses DELTA_BINARY_PACKED for INT32 and INT64 and DELTA_LENGTH_BYTE_ARRAY for BYTE_ARRAY columns (including the key), with data page v2. Asserted from the page headers.

datasets.name: optional-codecs
datasets.description: Valid. Value column brcol is BROTLI, outside the ENC-1 baseline: a reader or validator may support it or report it unsupported, but not when a request does not need it. Value column lz4col is LZ4_RAW, in the baseline. The key and size columns are SNAPPY.

datasets.name: lz4-raw
datasets.description: Every column, the key included, is LZ4_RAW (ENC-1 baseline, codec 7, not the legacy LZ4). Part 0 has data page v1 with dictionaries, part 1 data page v2 without; several key pages per row group.

datasets.name: brotli-key
datasets.description: Valid, but the key column is BROTLI, outside the ENC-1 baseline; the size column is SNAPPY. Structural validation needs no decompression and completes; a reader or validator without BROTLI answers requests, profile and full validation unsupported or incomplete.
